subject: Request: executive clearance for Sanctions & payment-term exception — Helion Dynamics
messages:
From: Sasha Romanov <sasha@heliondynamics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Purchase request + payment-term & clause asks (Helion)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo today — the team is excited. Two quick things from procurement before we can proceed: 1) they asked for net-90 payment terms for the first year, and 2) they want an explicit export-control carveout around satellite telemetry (they'll sign a clause that limits use to commercial operations in non-restricted countries).

We understand these are non-standard. Also, one of our subsidiaries is registered in a small EU jurisdiction — procurement asked that you confirm there are no sanctions implications before they route PO.

Attaching SOW draft and their procurement redlines. Can you escalate for approvals and advise next steps/timeline?

—Sasha
Sasha Romanov
Head of Procurement, Helion Dynamics
attachments: Helion_SOW_v3.pdf, payment_term_redlines.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Purchase request + payment-term & clause asks (Helion) — Need exec clearance

Team — forwarding Helion's asks. Summary: net-90 payment for year 1 + export-control carveout limited to commercial satellite telemetry in non-restricted countries. Procurement flagged a subsidiary in an EU jurisdiction and asked for a sanctions check.

Quick recommendation from sales: approve limited carveout (strictly scoped, logged usage + audit rights) and offer a one-time invoice schedule (70/30) as compromise instead of full net-90. If compliance flags the subsidiary, deal pauses.

Please review the attached screening file (run by our vendor) and Helion redlines. Need sign-off or escalation to exec for exception on payment terms and export language. Vivek — can you please weigh in on commercial concession budget for this?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Purchase request + payment-term & clause asks (Helion) — Need exec clearance

Karthik / Marissa — I've reviewed Helion's corporate registry and the screening vendor output. Summary: primary legal entity (Helion Dynamics Inc.) is clear; the subsidiary (HelionSat GmbH) showed a low-risk beneficial owner trace but flags in an adjacent watchlist for a related third-party in 2019. Not an outright sanctions hit but it increases our residual risk.

Controls I recommend if we proceed with carveout:
- Narrow clause: only telemetry metadata (no raw PII or demilitarized payload)
- Explicit geographic whitelist (list non-restricted countries)
- Quarterly audit rights + monitoring on KV/cache usage for telemetry prompts
- Customer must notify changes in ownership structure within 10 days

If clinical/engineering scope expands (raw payload), we should revoke the carveout immediately. I'll attach the vendor screening CSV.

—Aditya
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
attachments: sanctions-screening-report.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Purchase request + payment-term & clause asks (Helion) — Need exec clearance

Vivek — recommending escalation to executive for payment-term exception (net-90) and approval for the constrained export carveout with the controls Aditya listed. Commercial trade-off: 6% ACV credit / one-time onboarding credit to offset extended terms (approx $28k).

If you approve, legal will draft the clause with hard telemetry scoping, whitelist, audit language, and a 30-day kill switch tied to any ownership/sanctions changes. Also recommend we require purchase over a Redwood Dedicated tenancy to keep data isolation, which Helion has agreed to in principle.

Approver options: Vivek (VP Sales) can approve up to $50k credit. Anything above requires exec (CEO/CRO). Please confirm.

-Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Purchase request + payment-term & clause asks (Helion) — Approved (limited)

Thanks all — I approve the limited exception under the following conditions:
1) Payment term: we will accept 60 days (not 90) for year 1 with a signed SOW and a 70/30 invoice schedule documented in the amendment.
2) Export carveout: approved only for telemetry metadata; legal to add whitelist and a 30-day immediate revocation clause tied to ownership/sanctions changes.
3) Commercial concession: up to $30k one-time onboarding credit; finance (Laura) to confirm accounting impact and approvals.
4) Production on Redwood Dedicated and KMS-managed keys; security to configure monitoring.

Laura — please confirm if the $30k fits within current deal desk budget and next steps for contract amendment. Once Laura confirms, Marissa, please push the amendment to Helion and copy me on the send.

—Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
